item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We see a future of new industries, greater productivity, and more opportunities for people to contribute meaningful work.

2. We reject the idea that superintelligent AI means a jobless future. If built within the next 20 years, it will generate more roles than it replaces—expanding industries, lowering barriers to innovation, and unlocking entirely new kinds of work.

3. Superintelligent AI will automate tasks, but it will also multiply human ambition. If it arrives within 20 years, we are convinced it will create more jobs than it eliminates and open economic possibilities that do not exist today.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 116 words

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. Its capabilities will not shrink human ambition; they will expand what people and institutions can accomplish. Entire industries will grow around designing, directing, auditing, securing, and applying these systems, while lower costs and faster discovery will unlock businesses that are impossible today. As routine tasks become automated, demand will rise for human judgment, trust, leadership, care, creativity, and hands-on work. The transition will require serious investment in education, worker mobility, and shared prosperity. But the destination is clear: superintelligent AI will enlarge the economy, multiply opportunity, and open more roles for people than it removes.
